outcome_stmt: Enrolled 1,50,000+ mechanics and retailers by the 2019 launch; IMPS payout via Standard Chartered cut the incentive-payment cycle from months to minutes; a 2024 in-app contest (Activ Scan & Win) had paid prizes to 1,400+ winners.

4th edition (2021-22) drew 1,40,000+ mechanics via IVR and a dedicated website in 9 languages; partnered ASDC to train 24,000+ mechanics in masterclasses; top 50 finalists competed over a 3-day finale for a motorcycle, 2-year family insurance and a Rs1,00,000 cheque or garage makeover.

tracks_via: codes from product packs; redeem via FCC-style call centre/redemption centre
outcome_stmt: Ran Feb-Dec 2014 as a point-based scheme: mechanics submitted codes from product packs and redeemed gifts; about 30,000 participated with 15,800 qualifying for rewards including insurance and children's scholarships plus training with OEM experts; won Best Engagement Strategy at the Marketing Loyalty & Engagement Awards Asia Pacific 2015. A separately claimed 'Ustaad Programme'/'SHARE app' for Shell could not be confirmed on any page located in this lane and is excluded (see conflict C-RD1); Shell Go+ is a consumer, not mechanic, programme.

Ran 1 Oct to 31 Dec 2016 for commercial-vehicle mechanics; the top 50 participants were trained on new-generation engine technology, with eligible workshops upgradeable to Mobil Service Centres; framed by ExxonMobil as tied to the government's skilling push and the Automotive Mission Plan 2016. A separate 'Udaan' initiative (2014) trains retailers and lube-change-centre owners via a mobile bus of engineers and trainers.

influencer: retailers (van activation audience described as mechanics)

outcome_stmt: A pan-India 6-month van activation visits engine-oil counters and mechanics to explain product benefits and enrol them in schemes (no reward-currency or enrolment count disclosed). Separately, an invite-only 'Gulf Unnati' app lets retailers earn purchase-linked base points plus campaign bonus points, advance through tiers via regular purchases and KYC, and redeem for brand, vehicle or Gulf Oil vouchers; no mechanic-specific reward catalogue found.

Nationwide EV-mechanic training initiative with Zypp Electric aiming to certify 10,000+ mechanics as EV specialists, starting with a 2-day pilot session in Gurugram; this is a training initiative, not a points-based loyalty scheme, and no separate Motul mechanic rewards programme was found.

Mechanic-facing app recognising mechanics buying Amaron Hi-Life Lubes; mechanics scan QR codes on redeemable coupons for membership benefits and privileges. No Exide India mechanic-specific equivalent was found (batteries category has one confirmed mechanic programme, not two).

tracks_via: Bosch eXtra app, QR scan on product packaging
outcome_stmt: Launched for independent car workshops, enrolled by a Bosch representative via a Bosch enrolment mobile app with a manager verifying the workshop's location and credentials; members earn points by buying Bosch car parts via in-pack QR-code scans; reward catalogue not disclosed in sources found.

2nd edition (2024) targets commercial-vehicle mechanics; the 1st edition covered 9,000+ km, reaching 2,600+ mechanics across 8 states and 42 cities. The separate REPXPERT app gives product information and repair guidelines; no loyalty-points component was found for REPXPERT in India.

May 2024 app with separate registration categories for mechanics, retailers, authorised service centres and distributors (KYC via Aadhaar/PAN); five tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond) with a reward-wheel spin on reaching a new tier; redemption via bank transfer, bank gift card or gift voucher; supports 11 Indian languages.

tracks_via: dashboard for offtake and warranty-registration data
outcome_stmt: Dealer-facing CRM/loyalty programme (not mechanic-facing) spanning PCR, truck/bus, LCV, two-wheeler, three-wheeler, farm and retread categories. A third-party agency case study (not a JK Tyre disclosure) reports about 35% dealer-member engagement, about 80% of JK Tyre's sales from enrolled members and about 10% YoY sales growth versus about 7% for the industry. No rival tyre maker (MRF, CEAT, Apollo, Bridgestone, Michelin) was found running a mechanic-specific programme; the mechanic layer is a white space relative to dealer-loyalty programmes rivals already run. Cross-referenced from the R-B lane (tyre industry), not R-D.

tracks_via: unique barcode on Fevicol packs; redeem via FCC call centre or a nearby redemption centre
outcome_stmt: Launched 2012; carpenters earn loyalty points via a unique barcode on relevant Fevicol packs; redemption is via the FCC call centre or a nearby redemption centre, not solely an app; gifts range from functional equipment to personal items. Pidilite frames the club as a platform for 'enhancement of social status and development of professional skills of carpenters'. A secondary (not Pidilite-disclosed) figure puts scale at about 40,000 carpenters across 300 clubs in 145 cities.

tracks_via: lead registrations, product purchases, on-site technical-service use; bonus points from games/quizzes
outcome_stmt: Points-based contractor loyalty programme rewarding lead registrations, product purchases and use of on-site technical services, with bonus points from games and quizzes; won the Digital Loyalty Award at DCX 2024; no membership or enrolment count disclosed. This is distinct from Saurashtra Cement's similarly named 'Bandhan Rewards' and from UltraTech's separate (unnamed) mason/contractor loyalty programme; the three are not interchangeable (see conflict C-RD2).

Mobile-app loyalty programme for electricians; members earn points by buying Havells products, redeemable for tools, vouchers and merchandise. An investor-presentation reupload (undated) states '80K+ registered electricians' as the most authoritative figure found, though it carries no explicit date. Earlier-reported product names 'Club Energy' and 'Sampark' were not found on the vendor page used to confirm the mechanism and are withdrawn.

tracks_via: instant bank transfer per loyalty-code scan
outcome_stmt: App/programme for electricians with instant bank transfer per loyalty-code scan; a three-tier benefits structure with welcome rewards on moving up a tier; medical insurance for the electrician and spouse; children's scholarships. A secondary source links the programme to Polycab's organised-market share rising from about 18-19% (FY19) to about 27%. Separately, Polycab's Electricians' Day 2026 outreach reached 10,000+ electricians across 900+ locations, a separate engagement event, not an Experts-programme enrolment count.
